subject: pri-af-to
title: PRI.AF.TD.------ACC.DY.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-19, paired with v1-p115-1. (C)PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) is crossed with ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics): the question is what acceleration of dynamics does to primary affinity tendencies. PRI-AF-TD branches to AF-CON (affinity convergence) → C-INFO (composite information). PRI-AF-TD outputs to ACC-DY directly, and into INFO-DY (information dynamics) → MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), which then fans into two chains: → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) → MT-DEVF (multiple diversification); → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → POL-DYM (political dynamics). The structural argument: when affinity tendencies are accelerated, the resulting information dynamics do not flow whole — through multiple interpretation they diversify into two distinct downstream chains (dynamic functionalism→world expansion→diversification, physical-universe→progressional continuance→political dynamics).
